Impure Rage.effect: Dealing damage with skills deals 4% of target's Max HP extra Adaptive Damage and restores 2% Mana on hit. If the hero does not use Mana, restores 1% HP instead.

Quantum Charge.effect: Dealing damage with Basic Attacks increases Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s and restores 75-180 HP scaling with level.

War Cry.effect: The next Ultimate cast decreases other active skills' remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times within 4 seconds. Extended by 2 seconds after hero kills or assists.

Temporal Reign.effect: The next Ultimate cast decreases other active skills' remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times within 4 seconds. Extended by 2 seconds after hero kills or assists.

Tenacity.effect: When HP is below 50%, Damage Reduction is increased by 5%.

Concussive Blast.effect: After the next Basic Attack, deal 100(+7% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Master Assassin.effect: If there is only one enemy hero nearby, damage dealt to them is increased by 7%.

Killing Spree.effect: When damaging heroes below 30% HP, instantly recover 15% Lost HP and gain 20% Movement Speed. Resets cooldown upon killing an enemy hero.

Inspire.effect: Cooldown Reduction is increased by 5% and Mana Regen by 2.

Bargain Hunter.effect: Equipment can be purchased at 95% of their base price.

Lethal Ignition.effect: Dealing damage greater than 7% of an enemy hero's Max HP 3 times within 5s scorches the target for additional Adaptive Damage scaling with level.

Festival of Blood.effect: Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 0.5% Spell Vamp, up to 12 stacks.

Brave Smite.effect: Dealing skill damage to an enemy hero recovers 5% Max HP.

Pull Yourself Together.effect: Cooldowns of Battle Spells and equipment active skills are reduced by 12% initially. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 1% reduction, up to 8 stacks.

Focusing Mark.effect: After damaging an enemy hero, allied heroes deal 6% more damage to them and gain 10% Movement Speed.

Fatal.effect: Gain 5% Crit Chance and 5% extra Crit Damage.

Weapon Master.effect: Physical Attack and Magic Power gained from equipment, emblem, talents, and skills are increased by 8%.

Weakness Finder.effect: Basic Attacks slow enemies by 50% and reduce their Attack Speed by 30%.
